# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report potential security vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/saurabhav88/EnviousWispr/security/advisories/new).
If that form is unavailable, open a
[GitHub issue](https://github.com/saurabhav88/EnviousWispr/issues) asking only for a
private security contact. Do not include vulnerability details in that issue.
Avoid posting exploit details publicly before we have coordinated a fix.

Include the affected app version or website address, your macOS version where
relevant, reproduction steps, and the expected security impact. Remove API keys,
personal recordings, transcripts, and other sensitive information from examples.

For ordinary bugs and feature requests, use
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/saurabhav88/EnviousWispr/issues).

## Security updates

For app vulnerabilities, please check whether the problem also occurs in the
[latest published release](https://github.com/saurabhav88/EnviousWispr/releases/latest),
if you can do so safely. You can report without retesting.
Keeping the app up to date is recommended for receiving app security fixes.

## Automated scans

CodeQL scans GitHub Actions, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python in this repository.
Swift app scanning awaits
[GitHub support for the app's Xcode 27 toolchain](https://github.com/github/codeql/issues/22742#issuecomment-5949040893).
The coverage gap is tracked in [#3828](https://github.com/saurabhav88/EnviousWispr/issues/3828).
